background: KBC Group is a Belgian bancassurer, funded by retail deposits in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia and Bulgaria and lending to households and companies in those markets, with insurance and asset management alongside.
synthesis: Ratings are A from Fitch, A- from S&P on a positive outlook and A3 from Moody's after its upgrade on 26 Jul 2024, holding-company grades that sit below the bank's. Consolidated capital is on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers, with CET1 of 14.3% below the 16.4% median and leverage of 5.5% at the median. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 158% above the 151% median and NSFR of 133% in the top quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A steady name with liquidity as its clearer strength.
